title: LLM data
summary: One panel for whatever LLM is hooked up: model and file facts, the token budget from the record, the API rate window (peak / off-peak), and what the provider does not tell us.

surfaces.web: N/A(by steward decision 2026-09-20: the web portal does not need these modules - a browser tab has no local engine, no registry file, no receipts and no log files, so a card there could only be decoration)

notes: Read-only collector: it adds no state and writes nothing, so its gate is 'none'. It reports only facts another owner already holds - the selected model record (registry), the live window budget and the record counters (compaction.safe_status), the API switch and its last answer (cloud_api.public_status), the clock (world_clock.pulse) and the release (version) - and it names every fact it cannot get rather than filling the gap with a guess. The pane id is slot-prefixed ('dock.llm') because /api/modules publishes pane ids; the shell places a pane by its prefix - slot 'dock' is the console page's bottom strip, full length, one card per module, with the PAGE scrolling to it - so a pane reaches that strip without a shell edit, and no module can take room from the working area. inner_scroll is false on purpose: the page scrolls, not the pane. Rate windows are the PROVIDER's published policy, not our inference: only DeepSeek publishes one today (peak 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri, off-peak is half the peak rate) and the source URL travels with the answer. Promoted to the USB LYGO CLAW in 1.2.0 (as-built Addendum A7): the module and the pane host travelled together, every file sha256-verified against the PC tree, and the stick re-ran the tests.
